meta.notes: Edges filtered: reference===57 AND type==='bechina'. 19 unique bechina edges across 29 nodes yielded 10 raw connected components (A=5 nodes, B=4 nodes, C=3 nodes, D=5 nodes, E=2 nodes, F=2 nodes, G=2 nodes, H=2 nodes, I=2 nodes, J=2 nodes). Six small isolates (E, F, G, H, I, J) merged into thematically nearest larger packages based on shared bechina nature. Result: 5 final packages.

packages.label: יַעֲקֹב הַנֶּדֶר וְהָאֱמוּנָה
packages.reason: This cluster unites the positive axis of Torah #57: Yaakov, whose essential nature IS the vow (neder), accesses the hidden root of the Sages (pele = wonder) through that vow. The lack of faith in the Sages IS the concealment of the Sages (hisatlkut ha-chakhamim), which IS pele — the wonder-state where wisdom is hidden. Thus the chain is: neder = Yaakov; neder = pele; pele = hisatlkut ha-chakhamim; hisatlkut = loss of emunah. The letter shin (three-pronged, representing the three Patriarchs) and bat (= emunah, as in 'a daughter was born to Avraham and her name was Bakol') are the cosmological encoding of this same domain: the Patriarchs are the three-pronged shin, and the bat (daughter/emunah) is what unites with them to produce 'shin-bat' = Shabbat. All nine nodes share the common denominator of the positive constructive domain: faith in the Sages, the vow that restores it, and the Patriarchal light that the vow draws down.

merge_notes.reason: The letter shin IS the Patriarchs ('שִׁין זֶה בְּחִינַת אָבוֹת'). The Torah explicitly states that the vow (neder = Yaakov) draws down the light of the Patriarchs (orot ha-avot) — the same Patriarchs that the shin encodes. Shared nature: both express the dimension of Patriarchal light and the role of Yaakov within the trio. Component G belongs with Component A because the Patriarchs/shin/Yaakov constellation is the same conceptual family.

Bat = emunah ('בַּת זֶה בְּחִינוֹת אֱמוּנָה'). The Torah says: 'שִׁין בַּת' = Shabbat. Shin = the Patriarchs (Package 1); Bat = emunah (Package 1 — the same faith-in-Sages that the vow restores). Emunah is the daughter of the Patriarchs, just as the vow is the mode of Yaakov. Bat and emunah share the same essential nature as the faith dimension that the Yaakov/neder axis is designed to repair. They belong with the neder/pele/Patriarchs cluster.

packages.label: מַצָּה וְכֹחַ הַדִּבּוּר
packages.label_en: Matzah and the Power of Speech
packages.reason: This cluster encodes the highest level of peace — Shabbat-peace with speech (shalom she-yesh lo peh). Matzah is written with the letter heh (ה), which represents the five articulatory positions of the mouth (chamesh motza'ot ha-peh), which is the power of speech (koach ha-diburi). Matzah also IS the eating of Shabbat delight (akilat oneg Shabbat). Thus: matzah = Shabbat eating = letter heh = five mouth-positions = power of speech. All four nodes share the same essential nature: the domain of holy speech, the mouth's articulated capacity, which is the defining advantage of human over animal ('mevaker al chai'). This package represents the completion of the Shabbat tikkun at the level of human speech — the fullest expression of holiness.

packages.label: עֹנֶג שַׁבָּת וְשָׁלוֹם
packages.reason: This cluster centers on oneg Shabbat (Shabbat pleasure) as holy eating — eating from which the sitra achra receives no portion — and its production of shalom (peace). The gorel (lot) IS oneg Shabbat, because Daniel says 'you shall rest and stand for your lot at the end of days' (ve-tanuach ve-ta'amod le-goralekha le-ketz ha-yamin) — when all will be Shabbat. The sun (shemesh) IS peace, as the Sages state: 'just as the sun shines peace for all who enter the world.' Shemesh = shalom is merged into this package because the text explicitly connects the Shabbat-sun-peace triad: 'Shemesh be-Shabbat tzedaka la-aniyim' — the Shabbat sun is peace through charity. All five nodes share the essential nature of the Shabbat domain: the sacred, complete, sitra-achra-free dimension of holy pleasure, rest, and peace.

merge_notes.reason: Shemesh = shalom is explicitly stated as a bechina ('שֶׁמֶשׁ זֶה בְּחִינַת שָׁלוֹם'). The context is the Shabbat teaching: 'Shemesh be-Shabbat tzedaka la-aniyim' — the sun on Shabbat IS peace given to the poor through charity. The sun-as-peace is the Shabbat dimension of peace (the full speech-peace), not the fasting-peace (which is animal-level/without speech, in Package 4). Shemesh/shalom share the essential nature of the Shabbat-complete-peace domain and belong with the oneg Shabbat package.

packages.label: חָמֵץ וְהַתַּעֲנִית
packages.reason: This cluster represents the partial or lower-level peace achieved through fasting rather than Shabbat eating. Chametz IS fasting ('חָמֵץ זֶה בְּחִינַת הַכְנָעָתוֹ, בְּחִינַת תַּעֲנִית, בְּחִינַת הֶעְדֵּר אֲכִילָה'), which IS the tikkun of anger via fasting ('חָמֵץ זֶהוּ בְּחִינַת תִּקּוּן הַכַּעַס עַל יְדֵי הַתַּעֲנִית'). The peace produced by fasting IS 'shalom without speech' = chai (animal-level existence: 'בְּחִינַת חַי, בְּחִינַת וְחַיַּת הַשָּׂדֶה הָשְׁלְמָה לָּךְ — peace of the field animals, who have life but not speech'). The polarity is neutral because: (1) chametz as a concept is associated with the Edom/kaved domain (evil) in this Torah, yet (2) the tikkun of fasting is a positive corrective act, and (3) the peace achieved is real but partial — it subdues enemies but lacks the full power of speech. Chametz/fasting is neither the pure holy path (Shabbat/matzah) nor pure evil — it is the liminal, partial tikkun that reduces evil without achieving complete holiness.

packages.label: עֵשָׂו הַכָּבֵד וְשַׁעַר אֲרָם
packages.label_en: Esav, the Liver, and the Gate of Aram
packages.reason: This cluster unites all evil/opposing-force nodes in Torah #57. The liver (kaved) IS anger ('כָּבֵד כּוֹעֵס'), IS Edom/Esav ('אֱדוֹם זֶה בְּחִינַת כָּבֵד הַנַּ

merge_notes.reason: Edom = liver is an explicit bechina ('אֱדוֹם זֶה בְּחִינַת כָּבֵד'). Esav/Edom is the great accuser whose grip is on the liver. This pair is the core identification of the evil oppressor with the physiological seat of anger. It belongs in the evil package together with the other liver-anger nodes.

The rulers-of-anger ARE the enraged liver ('שׁוּלְטָנֵי רֻגְזִין, שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת כָּבֵד כּוֹעֵס'). They are the heavenly/cosmic forces empowered by human anger. Same evil domain as Component E — both describe the liver-anger-Esav nexus. Merged into the evil package as natural companions to אדום/כבד.

The gate of Aram IS the gate of the Other Side — the evil structure that falls three times and enables Mashiach to come. The Aram-gate/sitra-achra-gate pair is the macro-cosmic expression of the same evil domain: the Esav/liver/anger power has its cosmic gate. When that gate falls (through Shabbat eating, vow, and peace-producing practices), the gate of holiness rises in its place. Shared nature with E+F: all are manifestations of the same evil force at different levels (physiological = liver, cosmological = sitra achra gate). Merged into the evil package.
